name: Dravin
description: Gruul deserter who saw the golden-maned Blazing Archon and wept at the idiocy of war.

description_citations.text: Commander 2016: card flavor text (Commander 2016, 2016), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Dravin deserts after seeing a blazing archon and weeping at the idiocy of war.
timeline.quote: I dropped my sword and wept at the idiocy of war.
